lead.headline: 10 foreign groups hold 40% of US "social welfare" nonprofit assets, $133.4B; Mastercard Foundation and Novo Holdings lead
lead.number: $133.4B of $335.2B in 501(c)(4) assets; Mastercard Foundation (Toronto) $50.3B, Novo Holdings (Denmark) $36.2B; without those two, 20%
lead.watch_out: The share runs 39-41% depending on double counting (Novo Nordisk Fonden may own Novo Holdings) and on foreign groups at US addresses; the status is legal and may be tax-neutral.
